00-rps-tournament.concept_focus: Loops, conditionals and score state in a first-to-N match

mobs.name: The Mimic
mobs.concept: Input/output and random choice from a list
mobs.encounter: Get a single round on the table: take the player's move, let the computer pick its own, and explain where each choice is remembered.

mobs.name: The Rule Sage
mobs.encounter: Decide who wins a round by reasoning through ties, wins and losses without blindly writing out every pairing.

mobs.name: The Loop Imp
mobs.encounter: Make rounds repeat and explain which condition keeps the loop alive and what would end it.

mobs.name: The Score Thief
mobs.encounter: Track wins for both sides and pinpoint exactly where in a round each score is allowed to change.

mobs.name: The Trickster
mobs.encounter: Survive typos, capitals and nonsense so a bad move asks again instead of crashing or counting as a round.

mobs.name: The Crown Keeper
mobs.concept: Loop exit conditions and formatted output
mobs.encounter: End the match when someone reaches the target score, showing the round number and score along the way.

mobs.name: The Rule Splitter
mobs.encounter: Pull repeated jobs like getting a move and judging a round into small named behaviours and explain their inputs and returns.

mobs.name: The Rematch Wraith
mobs.concept: Outer game loop and reset state
mobs.encounter: Offer a rematch after a finished match and explain how scores and round counts start fresh without restarting Python.

02-detective-game.concept_focus: Dictionaries, lists of dictionaries and filtering data

mobs.name: The Lineup
mobs.encounter: Build the suspect roster and decide which traits each suspect needs so every one can be told apart.

mobs.name: The Witness Board
mobs.concept: Looping over lists and string output
mobs.encounter: Display the remaining suspects and their traits readably and explain how the loop visits each one.

mobs.name: The Interrogator
mobs.encounter: Offer a set of questions, take the player's pick and reason about which trait and value that question really checks.

mobs.name: The Vanishing Crowd
mobs.encounter: Narrow the suspects after an answer by comparing what you know before and after the question.

mobs.name: The False Lead
mobs.encounter: Handle questions that eliminate nobody or everybody and always show how many suspects remain.

mobs.name: The Case Clerk
mobs.encounter: Split asking, answering and filtering into named behaviours and explain what each receives and hands back.

mobs.name: The Accuser
mobs.encounter: Let the player make a final accusation and justify how the program knows whether the case is solved.

mobs.name: The Cold Case
mobs.concept: Turn limits, loop exits and reset state
mobs.encounter: Cap questions or wrong guesses so the case can be lost, then open a new case without leftovers from the filtered list.

03-pokemon-battle.concept_focus: Nested dictionaries, turn logic and state changes before classes

mobs.name: The Wild Slime
mobs.encounter: Design one creature with a name, HP, stats and a single move, and explain why each piece of data sits where it does.

mobs.name: The Feral Fang
mobs.encounter: Make one attack land and reason about which creature's data changes and which stays untouched.

mobs.name: The Miss Wisp
mobs.encounter: Give moves an accuracy so attacks can miss and explain how a random roll becomes a hit or a miss.

mobs.name: The Turn Goblin
mobs.encounter: Let both sides take repeated turns and trace whose turn it is at every point in the loop.

mobs.name: The Move Keeper
mobs.concept: Lists of dictionaries and menu input
mobs.encounter: Let the player pick from several moves and reject choices that do not exist.

mobs.name: The Mindless Rival
mobs.encounter: Have the enemy choose its own move each turn and explain how it reaches into the same move data as the player.

mobs.name: The Health Reaper
mobs.encounter: End the battle exactly when a creature hits 0 HP, keeping HP from going negative and stopping a fallen creature from striking back.

mobs.name: The Battle Bard
mobs.concept: String formatting and fresh state per battle
mobs.encounter: Make battle text and remaining HP readable, then explain how a new battle starts at full HP instead of carrying old wounds.

04-casino-slots.concept_focus: Randomness, probability thinking and bankroll (economy) state

mobs.name: The Coin Rat
mobs.encounter: Track a starting bankroll and explain which actions should make it grow or shrink.

mobs.name: The Spin Imp
mobs.encounter: Generate three random symbols per spin and reason about how many different outcomes are possible.

mobs.name: The Payout Mimic
mobs.encounter: Reward different combinations correctly and decide what order to check them in so a big win is never paid as a small one.

mobs.name: The Debt Ghoul
mobs.encounter: Block bets that are negative, zero, not a number or bigger than the bankroll, and ask again instead of crashing.

mobs.name: The House Edge
mobs.encounter: Estimate how often each combination should appear and judge whether your payouts let a player win forever.

mobs.name: The Greed Spirit
mobs.encounter: Keep the game running across many spins and explain every condition that ends the session.

mobs.name: The Croupier
mobs.encounter: Split taking bets, spinning and paying out into named behaviours with clear inputs and returns.

mobs.name: The Tally Ghost
mobs.encounter: Track wins, losses and net change across the session and present a clear summary when the player walks away.

05-dungeon-crawler.concept_focus: Connecting systems: encounters, inventory, shop and progression on shared state

mobs.name: The Hollow Adventurer
mobs.encounter: Decide what the player must carry between rooms and how to keep HP, attack, gold and potions together in one place.

mobs.name: The Tunnel Rat
mobs.encounter: Make one enemy fight work with attack and run choices, and explain when the enemy gets to act.

mobs.name: The Potion Leech
mobs.encounter: Let the player heal from a limited potion supply and reason about what should happen when it runs out.

mobs.name: The Gold Goblin
mobs.encounter: Award gold after a victory and explain why the reward must land on the same player state that survives into the next room.

mobs.name: The Spawn Pit
mobs.concept: Randomness and functions that build data
mobs.encounter: Generate enemies with different stats so fights vary, and explain where randomness enters each one.

mobs.name: The Merchant Shade
mobs.concept: Shop loop with lists and dictionaries
mobs.encounter: Build a shop that shows items and prices, checks affordability, updates gold and inventory, and lets the player leave empty-handed.

mobs.name: The Floor Stalker
mobs.encounter: Advance through numbered rooms with random events and reason about how the game knows a shop is due.

mobs.name: The Mini-Boss
mobs.encounter: Bring a tougher encounter every few rooms and end the run on death with a final score.

06-gladiator-arena.concept_focus: Reusable functions, turn-based combat state and run progression

mobs.name: The Rulescribe
mobs.concept: Planning state and turn order in comments
mobs.encounter: Sketch the combat rules and turn order before coding, naming every piece of state a fighter needs, including the secondary stat.

mobs.name: The Arena Recruit
mobs.encounter: Get one full duel working from first strike to a fallen fighter.

mobs.name: The Shield Bearer
mobs.encounter: Add a defend or block action and reason about how long its effect should last.

mobs.name: The Bloodletter
mobs.encounter: Add a stronger but riskier attack and argue when a player should gamble on it.

mobs.name: The Bookmaker
mobs.encounter: Award coins or XP after a win and let the player pick an upgrade or item before the next fight.

mobs.name: The Veteran
mobs.encounter: Give opponents different strengths and a simple rule for choosing actions, and explain why it is more than pure chance.

mobs.name: The Champion's Guard
mobs.encounter: Make each opponent tougher across the run and test whether the curve stays challenging but beatable.

mobs.name: The Fallen Laurel
mobs.encounter: End the run on defeat with a summary and start a new run without carrying over old upgrades or HP.

07-football-manager.concept_focus: Larger lists of dictionaries, interacting state and random simulation

mobs.name: The Scout
mobs.encounter: Build squad data with name, position, rating and value and show it in a readable way.

mobs.name: The Talent Spotter
mobs.encounter: Find players in the squad or market by position or rating and explain how the search decides who matches.

mobs.name: The Accountant
mobs.encounter: Track a club budget and decide whether a transfer is affordable before anything changes.

mobs.name: The Negotiator
mobs.encounter: Buy a player so budget, squad and market all change together, and explain what breaks if only one of them does.

mobs.name: The Gaffer
mobs.encounter: Pick a simplified starting lineup from the squad and reject selections that are impossible or incomplete.

mobs.name: The Tactician
mobs.encounter: Reduce a lineup to a single team-strength number and justify why your formula is fair.

mobs.name: The Match Engine
mobs.encounter: Produce believable results from team strength plus randomness, where the stronger side usually but not always wins.

mobs.name: The Fixture Keeper
mobs.encounter: Run several matches in a row and keep a running record of wins, draws and losses.
